title: Free differential in adjunction coordinates
statement: Let R be a normalized free-resolution datum from [lem-sf-cyclic-free-resolution-coordinates]. Write e0 and e1 for the additive Hom coordinates of [lem-sf-cyclic-free-hom-coordinates]. For every M,N and u in V^0, e0(d_M followed by e0 inverse of T(u)) = -(1-T)(u). For every u in V^-1, e1(d_M[1] followed by e1 inverse of T(u)) = -(1-T)(u). This calculates a differential; no exactness or boundary assertion is included.

source.place: Tags 0149, 0152 and 015F; parent calculus steps 1--2 and normalized free-resolution steps 5--9.

proof.text: For chain representatives, evaluate the free adjunct on summand zero. The normalized differential is 1 minus the backward shift, so precomposition corresponds to 1-T inverse. Evaluate this at T(u) to get T(u)-u. Transport through differential_fac and the exact-functor localization comparisons. For the shifted formula, move the source shift to the target and repeat with N[-1]; the shift comparison in the definition of T is the same as in e1.

proof_origin.place: Explicit proof of parent calculus steps 1--2 using the existing normalized cyclic resolution, Stacks 0149, 0152, 015F.

theorem cyclicDerivedFreeDefect_coordinates (R : CyclicDerivedFreeResolution F)
    (M N : DerivedCategory (IsoAlgebra F)) :
    (∀ u : CyclicDerivedHom F M N 0,
      cyclicDerivedFreeHomEquiv F M N
        (R.differential.app M ≫ (cyclicDerivedFreeHomEquiv F M N).symm
          (cyclicDerivedHomAction F M N 0 u)) = -cyclicDerivedHomDefect F M N 0 u) ∧
    (∀ u : CyclicDerivedHom F M N (-1),
      cyclicDerivedFreeShiftedHomEquiv F M N
        ((R.differential.app M)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' ≫
          (cyclicDerivedFreeShiftedHomEquiv F M N).symm
            (cyclicDerivedHomAction F M N (-1) u)) =
        -cyclicDerivedHomDefect F M N (-1) u)
